title: Hof signed backup tool lock
description: Independent of release-lock-v1 (ADR 0006) - pins the exact signed Execution Environment image, and the exact restic/sops/age versions baked into it, that hofctl backup/restore actually trusts and dispatches its target-side runner from. Deliberately versioned under its own backup-tool-vX.Y.Z tag namespace, distinct from both platform vX.Y.Z releases and ee-vX.Y.Z Execution Environment tags, so a backup-tool fix can ship - and v0.2.3 (already published, no backup path at all) can get a real one - without cutting a new platform release at all, breaking what would otherwise be an upgrade-needs-backup-needs-upgrade cycle. Never $ref's release-lock-v1.schema.json (this repo's own no-cross-file-$ref convention) - the shared artifact shape is copied independently.

sourceTag.description: backup-tool-vX.Y.Z - never plain vX.Y.Z (a platform release) or ee-vX.Y.Z (the Execution Environment alone) - three independent tag namespaces in one repository must never be able to collide.

image.description: Digest-pinned, never a tag - the same Execution Environment image the runner and its pinned restic/sops/age binaries are delivered from.

signatureIdentity.description: The Cosign keyless signing identity (a GitHub Actions workflow path) - the exact same trust mechanism release-lock-v1's own first-party components already use.

pinnedTools.description: The exact restic/sops/age versions baked into this image at build time - the target-side runner refuses to start if what it actually finds on disk doesn't match, rather than silently trusting whatever binary happens to be present.
